description: This file defines the 'ModifyFeatures' command class used for modifying features of a 'Thing' in the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for creating instances from JSON, accessing command details, and managing the command's payload, such as features and thing ID.

classes.name: ModifyFeatures
classes.description: A command class used for modifying features of a Thing, encapsulating details like the thing ID and new features, and supporting JSON serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ModifyFeatures using typed ThingId, features, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a ModifyFeatures instance from a JSON string or object.

methods.name: getFeatures
methods.description: Returns the features to be modified.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the Thing this command targets.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the JSON representation of the features.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Provides the JSON pointer path to the features resource.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Adds the command's payload to a JSON object builder.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is MODIFY.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified headers.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates whether the command changes authorization. Returns false.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on the object properties.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Helper for equality check, verifying the other object is of type ModifyFeatures.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the object.
